## Working papers

::: {.entry}
[Bayesian Treatment Imputation for CATE Estimation Under Missing Binary Treatments]{.entry-title} [In preparation]{.entry-date}
[**Lim, J.** & Reiter, J. P.]{.entry-meta}

A fully Bayesian data augmentation Gibbs sampler that jointly updates a BART outcome model, a
probit propensity model, and partially missing binary treatments in a single chain, propagating
the parameter uncertainty that sequential multiple imputation discards.
:::

::: {.entry}
[Bayesian Causal Inference: A Practical Guide]{.entry-title} [In preparation]{.entry-date}
[**Lim, J.** & Li, F. · for the *Journal of Statistical Software*]{.entry-meta}

Introduces **BayesCausal**, an R package for Bayesian estimation of average and heterogeneous
treatment effects under unconfoundedness, instrumental variables, and panel designs behind a
single formula interface, with Stan/HMC posterior inference.
:::

## Software

::: {.entry}
[BayesCausal]{.entry-title} [R package]{.entry-date}
[Bayesian causal inference under unconfounded, instrumental variable, and panel designs]{.entry-meta}

One formula interface across three identification settings, with structured priors, a selectable
estimator, and Stan/HMC posterior inference. Manuscript in preparation for the
*Journal of Statistical Software*.
:::
